result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders.

The change is a single condition in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart07.java`. The purchase-order subquery now also requires `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the per-quarter report uses. Reps with no matching orders still come back with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes under `mvn -o`. I did not add a test for the cancelled case, so the existing suite is the only check. Nothing is committed.
